title: scrophularia umbrosa subsp. neesii
intro: Scrophularia umbrosa subsp. neesii, commonly known as Woodland Figwort or Common Figwort, is a plant species in the figwort family Scrophulariaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as iridoid glycosides and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Scrophularia umbrosa subsp. neesii, including scrophularin and figwortine, contribute to its therapeutic potential in treating various health conditions.
